neon-sign.purpose: The restaurant name, inner-page H1s, phone number, figures; lit with the glow on night only.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the menu card title.

price.purpose: Tabular prices; BGN at 13px faded ink beside EUR.

script-note.purpose: Postcard and lightbox captions; red script subtitles on paper.

shadows.name: neon-glow
shadows.purpose: text-shadow for lit script on night only.

shadows.name: bulb-halo
shadows.purpose: Bulbs on the string; bullets use box-shadow 0 0 8px #FF9B4A.

shadows.name: postcard-drop
shadows.purpose: Postcards hung or lying on night.

shadows.name: street-plaque
shadows.purpose: Painted inset border and cast shadow of the street plaque.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus halo on paper fields; menu search on night uses 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,155,74,.2).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for arrivals, hover lifts, press, underline draws.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Drawer circle reveal and menu panel wipe.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Declared drawer curve; not referenced by current rules.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every pressable; identical in both motion modes.

motion.name: neon-switch-on
motion.value: flicker 1600ms linear, then hum 5s ease-in-out infinite (opacity 1 to .9)
motion.purpose: Hero sign and inner-page titles, full motion.

motion.name: neon-light-on-arrival
motion.purpose: neon--dim text lit by IntersectionObserver at 25%; both modes.

motion.name: bulbs
motion.value: bulb-on 500ms staggered 70ms, then twinkle 3.6s/4.4s to .45 opacity
motion.purpose: String of bulbs; light-only, both modes.

motion.name: postcard-drop
motion.value: drop 900ms ease-out (translate -40px, scale 1.06 to 1), staggered 150ms from 900ms
motion.purpose: Hero postcards, full motion; copy rises 18px over 800ms from 700ms.

motion.name: postcard-fade-reduced
motion.value: fade 900ms ease-out (opacity 0 and blur 6px to clear), staggered 200ms from 700ms
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion twin for hero postcards and copy.

motion.name: pointer-lean
motion.purpose: Hero postcards follow the pointer; fine pointer and full motion only.

motion.name: rail-swing
motion.value: from rotate(tilt x -4), opacity .2; 900ms ease-out, staggered 90ms
motion.purpose: Postcards on the string arriving, full motion.

motion.name: rail-swing-reduced
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion twin of the rail swing.

motion.name: leaf-wall-part
motion.value: leaves translateX(+-101% x p), photo scale 1.18 to 1, copy fades at p > .86

motion.name: leaf-wall-reduced
motion.value: leaves opacity 1 - p x 1.4, no translate, no scale
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion twin of the leaf wall.

motion.name: feast-settle
motion.purpose: Celebration scene, full motion only; static under reduced motion.

motion.name: menu-wipe
motion.purpose: Menu tab panel change; both modes.

motion.name: drawer-reveal
motion.value: clip-path circle 0% to 150% 620ms in / 520ms out ease-in-out; links fade 400ms staggered 60ms
motion.purpose: Mobile drawer; clip-based so kept in both modes.

motion.name: lightbox
motion.value: opacity 250ms ease-out; image opacity + scale .96 to 1 280ms

components.name: Enamel Plaque (red)
components.description: Call and reserve actions; the only saturated solid on the night ground.
components.html: Обадете се 032 968 778
components.css: .ds-plaque { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--enamel, #C7372A); color: var(--enamel-ink, #FFF4E4); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--f-text, Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: .01em; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14), 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.6); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-plaque svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-plaque:hover { background: var(--enamel-deep, #A0281E); } .ds-plaque:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-plaque:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--neon-1, #FFB373); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Enamel Plaque (cream)

components.description: Quiet action on night, e.g. send an inquiry.
components.css: .ds-plaque-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #ECE4D2); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--f-text, Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(236,228,210,.45); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-plaque-ghost:hover { background: rgba(236,228,210,.08); } .ds-plaque-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-plaque-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--neon-1, #FFB373); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Neon Sign
components.description: The lit name; flickers on once then hums, or glows in under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-night { background: #0A1612; padding: 32px; } .ds-neon { margin: 0; font-family: 'Marck Script', 'Segoe Script', cursive; font-size: 72px; line-height: .9; color: #FFE6C9; text-shadow: 0 0 1px #fff7ec, 0 0 8px #FFB373, 0 0 22px #FF7A33, 0 0 46px rgba(255,110,40,.55), 0 0 96px rgba(255,90,30,.32); animation: ds-flicker 1600ms linear both, ds-hum 5s ease-in-out 1800ms infinite; } @keyframes ds-flicker { 0% { opacity: .08; text-shadow: none; } 8% { opacity: 1; } 11% { opacity: .15; } 24% { opacity: .9; } 27% { opacity: .3; } 45%, 100% { opacity: 1; } } @keyframes ds-hum { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .9; } } @keyframes ds-glow-in { from { opacity: .15; text-shadow: none; } to { opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-neon { animation: ds-glow-in 1400ms ease-out both; } }

components.name: Postcard
components.description: The restaurant's own photograph as a white-bordered postcard with a script caption.
components.css: .ds-night { background: #0A1612; padding: 40px; } .ds-pc { position: relative; margin: 0; width: 240px; background: #FBF5EA; padding: 10px 10px 40px; transform: rotate(-2.4deg); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4) inset, 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.75), 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.5); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-pc:hover { transform: rotate(0) translateY(-6px); } .ds-pc-img { aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #23453A, #183128); } .ds-pc figcaption { position: absolute; left: 14px; bottom: 8px; font: 400 21px/1 'Marck Script', cursive; color: #4a3f33; }

narrative.northStar: The Lit Sign Above the Hidden Garden
narrative.overview:
Every surface is an evening visit to the restaurant. The ground is a night garden, deep green going to black. On it hang the things a Balkan restaurant actually puts in front of a guest after dark: its name in a warm neon tube of script, red enamel plaques that say what to do, the restaurant's own photographs as white-bordered postcards pegged to a string of bulbs, a cream printed menu card with dotted price leaders, and a blue enamel street plaque with the address. Nothing is a generic card or a flat panel; each container is one of these objects, and its material decides its colour, corner and shadow.

Density is low and theatrical on the night ground (huge script, few words, one scene per screen) and high and orderly on the paper (two columns of dishes, tabular prices). The two never blend: night-ground surfaces glow, paper surfaces are printed. Motion is the sign switching on: tubes flicker and hum, bulbs light one by one, the leaf wall parts on scroll, postcards drop and swing, the menu wipes in like a turned page. Every one of these keeps a reduced-motion form built from opacity, glow, blur and clip, because the client's own machine runs with reduced motion; the motion is translated, never removed.
keyCharacteristics: Night-garden green ground (`night`, `canopy`, `moss`, `leaf`) with warm radial glows, never a pale page.
Three faces with fixed jobs: Marck Script for light, Oranienbaum for speech, Onest for information.
Actions are enamel plaques; nothing else is a button.
Photographs are objects (postcards) or scenes (full-bleed with night shade), never bare grid tiles.
Paper is a separate material with its own ink, its own red, and no glow.
A two-tier motion grammar: movement under full motion, light and clarity under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Act-In-Red Rule
rules.body: On the night ground, solid enamel red appears only on things you press to call, reserve or send. Its scarcity is what makes the phone number findable.

rules.name: The Glow-Needs-Night Rule
rules.body: The neon glow stack exists only on night surfaces. On paper the same script is printed in `enamel-deep` with no shadow.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Script is light, Oranienbaum is speech, Onest is fact. A price, hour or address is never set in script or display; the name of the place is never set in Onest.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Every price, phone number and capacity uses tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Objects Cast, Ground Glows Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to objects and always fall downward and soft; colour light belongs to neon and bulbs. Nothing on the ground gets a shadow, and no object glows.

dos: **Do** set every surface on the night ground (`night`) and bring warmth with radial glows (amber at 12–16%, leaf at 65%), not with lighter backgrounds.
**Do** make every action an enamel plaque, red for calling or reserving, cream or ghost for everything else.
**Do** present photographs as postcards (10px white border, deeper bottom, slight rotation) or as full-bleed scenes under a night gradient.
**Do** put lists of prices on paper with dotted leaders and tabular numerals.
**Do** give every movement a reduced-motion twin built from opacity, blur, glow or clip, and keep light-only motion (bulbs, hum, menu wipe) unchanged in both modes.
**Do** restrict hover effects to `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and give every pressable a 0.95–0.97 press scale.
donts: **Don't** put the neon glow on paper or on Onest text; on paper the script is printed in `enamel-deep`.
**Don't** use solid enamel red on night surfaces for anything that is not an action.
**Don't** add a fourth typeface or set facts (prices, hours, phone, address) in script or display.
**Don't** use stock food photography; only the restaurant's own photographs appear.
**Don't** drop motion entirely under reduced motion, and don't keep parallax, slides, swings or pointer-follow in it.
**Don't** give ground-level elements shadows or make objects glow; shadows are for objects, glow is for light sources.
